market.question: Will Gold (GC) hit (HIGH) $7,000 by end of December?

assessment.reasoning: Gold spot ~$4,700 / June futures ~$4,725 on Apr 27, 2026. Hitting $7,000 by end-December requires a ~49% rally in 8 months. Even amid Iran war / Hormuz crisis, gold's annualized vol of ~15-20% makes such a move a low-probability tail event. Forecasts cluster well below $6k.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Black-swan financial crisis or much wider war scenario
